# KBG Injury Law

> > KBG Injury Law is a York, Pennsylvania-based personal injury and workers compensation law firm offering free consultations for accident victims, workers, and seniors across South Central Pennsylvania.

KBG Injury Law specializes in personal injury claims, workers compensation, and disability law throughout York County and South Central Pennsylvania. The firm handles cases ranging from car and truck accidents to medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, and social security disability appeals, with a focus on negligence claims and fault determination.
